summary: Phase A (Discovery & Foundation) for the Partner API v1 was tested end-to-end against the external URL. All 14 pytest cases PASS covering /status (public, no auth), /capabilities, /inventory, /markets, /targeting/options, /rate-card, /stations (cursor pagination + station_type=radiolife + invalid_cursor normalized envelope), unauthenticated normalized 401 envelope, X-Request-ID + X-RadioLife-API-Version response headers on every response (including error responses), and regression on /me, /products, and /openapi.json (new paths present, legacy `detail` field still on errors for backward compat).
critical_code_review_comments: services/ad_product_registry.py inventory() de-dupes on `label` only, so if two future categories share a label the second silently drops (currently fine — 14 unique labels).

routes/partner_api_v1.py::stations_ep: query for station_type='radiolife' filters {active: true} but does not paginate (to_list(200)); acceptable for 14 channels but should be paginated once channel count grows.
The `country` filter on /stations upper-cases the value; passing lower-case still works but is undocumented. Consider documenting in OpenAPI.

services/partner_api.py::PRODUCTS and services/ad_product_registry.py::REGISTRY are two overlapping catalogs — future phases should collapse to a single source of truth to prevent drift (Phase A intentionally keeps both for backward compat with /products).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing RadioLife AI channels (14) and imported_radio_stations (AE country).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A discovery endpoints are fully green. Verified: 17 total campaign_types with exactly 7 api_bookable; 6 markets (dubai,new_york,london,mumbai,los_angeles,dfw); 8 base_rates + 5 multipliers on rate-card; 14 RadioLife AI channels; cursor pagination on /stations?country=AE returns disjoint pages; invalid_cursor -> 400 with normalized {error:{code:'invalid_cursor', request_id:...}} while preserving legacy `detail`; unauth -> 401 {error:{code:'missing_bearer_token'}}. Every response (including errors) carries X-RadioLife-API-Version:1 and X-Request-ID (echoed when supplied). /openapi.json exposes the new paths. Regression /me and /products unchanged.
